text: @linxin666/dsh-everything-search 为 DSH 提供 Windows 文件搜索工具。它通过 Everything 的 es.exe 查询本机索引，并注册 everything_search 与 everything_status。搜索支持文件名、可选目录范围、结果数量限制、忽略 node_modules 和 .git，并按匹配程度排序；状态工具检查后端是否可用。适合需要在本机快速定位文件的 DSH 用户。需要 Windows、Everything 和 es.exe，无需 API 密钥。

@linxin666/dsh-everything-search adds local Windows file search to DSH through Everything's es.exe. Agents can find files by name, limit searches to a folder, filter noisy paths, and check backend availability. It suits users locating files from DSH. Requires Windows and Everything; no API key.
想让 DSH 智能体快速按文件名找到电脑上的文件。
能不能只在指定 Windows 文件夹里搜索匹配的文件？
I want my DSH agent to find local files by name without scanning folders recursively.
@linxin666/dsh-everything-search 的功能「按名称查找文件」：智能体调用 everything_search 并提供查询词，可选指定根目录、结果上限和忽略噪声路径；工具返回排序后的文件路径。
@linxin666/dsh-everything-search 的功能「检查搜索后端」：智能体调用 everything_status，查看 es.exe 位置和 Everything 是否可用；工具也会在适用时尝试启动后端。
@linxin666/dsh-everything-search 的维护与更新元数据：低活跃；距最后推送 88 天；提交数 1；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 47/100（置信度 low）。

@linxin666/dsh-everything-search README · dsh-everything-search：Instant filename search for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) agents, backed by [voidtools Everything](https://www.voidtools.com/). Registers two host-side agent tools:

@linxin666/dsh-everything-search README · dsh-everything-search：- **`everything_search`** — whole-index filename queries in **milliseconds** (reads the NTFS MFT index, never a slow recursive directory walk), with optional path scoping, `node_modules`/`.git` noise filtering, and exact/prefix/substring ranking.
- **`everything_status`** — reports whether the Everything backend is usable, where `es.exe` was found, and what to do if it is not.

@linxin666/dsh-everything-search README · dsh-everything-search：> ⚠️ **Windows-only.** Everything indexes NTFS volumes on Windows; on other platforms the tools return a clear error telling the agent to fall back to the regular `glob`/`grep` tools.

@linxin666/dsh-everything-search README · Install：Requires [pnpm](https://pnpm.io/) and a [DSH profile](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

@linxin666/dsh-everything-search README · Backend requirements：The tools shell out to `es.exe` (the Everything command-line interface). It is discovered from, in order:

1. the `EVERYTHING_ES` environment variable,
2. `~/.dsh/bin/everything/es.exe` (the portable Everything layout used by DSH Desktop),
3. `Program Files` / `Program Files (x86)` / `%LOCALAPPDATA%` Everything installs,
4. `es.exe` on `PATH`.

@linxin666/dsh-everything-search README · Backend requirements：Install Everything from <https://www.voidtools.com/> (or run the portable copy under `~/.dsh/bin/everything`). Everything must be running (it stays in the tray); if it is installed but not running, the plugin attempts to start it once with `Everything.exe -startup` and retries.

@linxin666/dsh-everything-search README · `everything_search`：| Parameter      | Type    | Default | Description |
| -------------- | ------- | ------- | ----------- |
| `query`        | string  | —       | Filename substring (case-insensitive). `*`/`?` pass through as Everything search syntax. |
| `root`         | string  | —       | Absolute Windows folder to scope the search to (e.g. `Z:\Programming\SmartQuestApp`). Omit for the whole machine. |
| `limit`        | integer | 50      | Max results (cap 200). |
| `skipNoise`    | boolean | `true`  | Drop `node_modules`/`.git` paths from results. |
| `content`      | boolean | `false` | Search file contents instead of names (requires Everything content indexing). |
| `caseSensitive`| boolean | `false` | Match case exactly. |

@linxin666/dsh-everything-search README · `everything_search`：Results are ranked like the GUI file tree: exact name match, then prefix, then substring; shorter paths first; alphabetical tie-break. Each hit is `{ path, name, isDir }` (folders are excluded — they are found via path prefixes anyway).
@linxin666/dsh-everything-search README · `everything_status`：No parameters. Returns `backend`, `esPath`, `reachable`, optional `error`/`detail`, and a human-readable `hint`.

@linxin666/dsh-everything-search README · Development：```bash

cd dsh-everything-search
pnpm install            # pulls @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools for type-checking/imports
node .test-tmp/run-test.mjs   # standalone smoke test against the real es.exe

dsh plugin --profile web add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-everything-search
